lead.event: Rupiah reaches successive record lows on November 12–13, 2026
lead.headline: Rupiah sets successive record lows, opening at Rp18,233 per US dollar
lead.blurb: The rupiah had closed at Rp18,239 per US dollar on 12 November, down 0.50% or Rp90 and also reported as a historical low. Bank Indonesia attributed the weakness mainly to expectations of US rate hikes in December and domestic concerns over political uncertainty and MSCI’s consultation on Indonesia’s market classification. Danamon economist Irman Faiz warned the currency could test Rp18,300-Rp18,400 in the coming weeks. Bank Indonesia said it would continue foreign-exchange intervention through NDF, DNDF, spot transactions and government bond purchases.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to lead

other.event: Fitch downgrades BUMA and DOID debt ratings over liquidity risks
other.headline: Fitch downgrades DOID to CC(idn) and BUMA to CCC-(idn)
other.blurb: Fitch cited liquidity pressure and high refinancing risk at BUMA, whose roughly USD66 million in cash at September-end was insufficient to cover about USD200 million of obligations due through September 2027. BUMA faces a further IDR201 billion payment on 28 December, while Fitch said DOID had a similar credit profile.

other.event: Commercial Court declares TOPS bankrupt after revoking its peace agreement
other.headline: Commercial Court declares TOPS bankrupt after canceling debt accord
other.blurb: The Commercial Court at the Central Jakarta District Court canceled Totalindo Eka Persada’s debt-restructuring peace agreement in a 5 November ruling following creditor Sutoyo’s petition. The company received notice on 9 November and is reviewing legal steps, while acknowledging material uncertainty about its ability to continue as a going concern.

deals_control.headline: IDEA shareholders approve Nawasena's 66.58% acquisition
deals_control.blurb: The transaction covers 707.32 million shares at Rp53.73 each, for about Rp38 billion, giving Nawasena majority ownership. The meeting also approved changes to Idea Indonesia's board and an amendment to its business classification.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

earnings_guidance.event: MNC Sekuritas lowers BBRI’s price target after third-quarter earnings
earnings_guidance.headline: MNC Sekuritas cuts BBRI price target despite 16% Q3 profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Rakyat Indonesia posted Q3 net profit of Rp16.8 trillion, up 16% year-on-year, while nine-month profit of Rp47.7 trillion equaled 80% of MNC Sekuritas and consensus forecasts for 2026. The earnings beat was driven by a 30.6% quarterly decline in credit loss provisions, as net interest income fell 7.6% and net interest margin narrowed to 7.4% year-to-date.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset downgrades BRMS and cuts its target price
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset downgrades BRMS to hold and cuts target price to Rp310
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia cut its target from Rp760, citing limited upside as the stock nears fair value. The broker projects net profit to rise 133% to US$81 million in 2027.

earnings_guidance.event: Jasa Marga Q3 results and outlook for performance recovery in 2027
earnings_guidance.headline: JSMR’s net profit falls 2.57% through Q3 as analysts see 2027 recovery
earnings_guidance.blurb: Jasa Marga’s revenue fell 1.23% year on year to Rp20.82 trillion through September, while average daily traffic was about 3.6 million vehicles. BRI Danareksa analyst Abida Massi Armand recommends buying the shares, with a Rp4,750 target price.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Average daily traffic was about 3.6 million vehicles through Q3 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: ADES reports record Q3 2026 revenue and slower profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: ADES reports record Q3 revenue of Rp1.21 trillion as profit growth slows
earnings_guidance.blurb: Akasha's gross profit margin fell to 46.4%, its lowest since Q2 2021, while net profit rose 2.4% quarter on quarter to Rp281 billion. The company plans to propose a 1:10 stock split at an extraordinary general meeting on 16 December, with trading at the new Rp100 nominal value scheduled from 15 January 2027.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Merdeka Gold plans a private placement of 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EMAS plans a private placement of 1.47 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The new shares would equal 10% of placed and paid-up capital, at a nominal Rp150 each and fully paid. Proceeds are allocated approximately 25% to working capital, 50% to business development and 25% to refinancing or settling obligations, subject to shareholder approval on 26 November.
